texte.Une action à « +# » n’est pas inutile :: An action at “+#” is not useless: either it sets the direction of the points, or its gain is withheld by a blocker — and it is the blocker that needs treating, not the action.
texte.Une analyse d’impact RGPD déjà faite ne: A GDPR impact assessment already carried out does not count as a FRIA, and the reverse is also true: the two protect different things and are conducted separately.
texte.Une appréciation non refaite est le défa: An assessment that has not been redone is the most common defect at the first surveillance audit — the one where the effort was relaxed.
texte.Une association qui instruit l'éligibili: An association that examines eligibility for an essential social benefit on behalf of a local authority falls under Annex III, point #(a) — which covers systems used “by public authorities or on behalf of public authorities”. Delegation does not dilute the obligation, it moves it.
texte.Une autorité de contrôle demande la list: A supervisory authority asks for the list of people trained and the date, not the intention to train. Record completions as you go.
texte.Une base de départ chiffrée, à reprendre: A quantified baseline, to be taken up again in six months — it is the gap between two measurements that proves a training plan has been of use.
texte.Une capture d’écran n’est pas une source: A screenshot is not a source: keep the link, the publisher and the date of consultation.
A mapping of the risks to be treated.
texte.Une clause absente ne se rattrape pas ap: A missing clause cannot be recovered after signature: the contract has to be reopened, and the provider has no interest in doing so.
texte.Une colonne « propriétaire » remplie ne: A filled-in “owner” column does not count as the dated acceptance that clause # e) requires. The auditor asks for the signature, not the name.
texte.Une comparaison n’est pas une équivalenc: A comparison is not an equivalence
texte.Une culture de conformité entretenue et: A compliance culture that is maintained and traceable.
texte.Une divergence normative est rarement un: A regulatory divergence is rarely a definitive obstacle: it is a cost and a delay. The useful question is by how much, not whether.

texte.Une entité essentielle peut être auditée: An essential entity can be audited without notice and without an incident. Evidence is kept up to date, not produced on demand.
texte.Une entité essentielle subit des audits: An essential entity is subject to ad hoc audits after a significant incident — it is written in Article #(#)(c).
texte.Une entité importante n’a pas à formalis: An important entity does not have to formalise this approach: the screen says so instead of displaying a zero that would be read as a failure.

texte.Une exigence NON RENSEIGNÉE n’est pas un: A requirement that is NOT PROVIDED is not a compliant requirement. A rate calculated on three rows says nothing about the eighteen others — and it is that rate that gets shown in committee.

texte.Une file vide ne signifie pas qu’aucun u: An empty queue does not mean that no use exists: it means that none has gone through the approval workflow.
texte.Une fois le terrain situé, chiffrez : en: Once the site is located, cost it: envelope, breakdown by DPGF lot, comparison between scenarios.
texte.Une grille de lecture extérieure sur un: An external reading grid on a subject that is always assessed optimistically in-house.
texte.Une hiérarchie des risques du projet fon: A hierarchy of the project’s risks based on dated and sourced facts, not on announcements.
texte.Une information claire est fournie aux p: Clear information is provided to data subjects
texte.Une lecture d’ensemble qui révèle les zo: An overall reading that reveals the areas of attention.
texte.Une liste courte de cas d’usage priorisé: A shortlist of prioritised and costed use cases, where the workshop had produced a long, flat list.
texte.Une liste opposable au vendeur, écrite a: A list you can hold the vendor to, written before the negotiation and not during it.

texte.Une mesure non renseignée n’est pas une: A control that is not provided is not a compliant control. The number of empty rows is displayed next to the rate, on purpose.
texte.Une mesure retenue mais non mise en œuvr: A control that is included but not implemented covers nothing — and it is on the SoA that this shows.
texte.Une mesure taillée ne peut pas être plus: A tailored control cannot be stronger than the control it tailors. An axis declared above its family #-# is brought back down to it — and the overrun is FLAGGED. Lowering it silently would make the defect that needs showing disappear from the screen.
texte.Une mesure « touche » un risque ; elle n: A measure “touches” a risk; it does not close it. The bridge does not say otherwise.
texte.Une mesure écartée avec justification se: A control excluded with a justification can be defended; an empty box cannot. That holds in front of the auditor as much as in front of the authority.
texte.Une montée en compétence homogène plutôt: A uniform skills build-up rather than scattered knowledge depending on who has had the time to train.
texte.Une organisation peut être parfaitement: An organisation can be perfectly compliant on a tool nobody opens. Generated by Sentinel AI.
texte.Une partie des articles trouve un répond: Some of the articles find a direct counterpart in Annex A: that much evidence already produced, and that much time that is not paid twice.
texte.Une personne nommée, qui accepte l’indis: A named person, who accepts the unavailability if it occurs.
texte.Une pièce qui survit à la réunion : c’es: A document that outlives the meeting: it is what will circulate internally at the prospect, once you are no longer there.
texte.Une plateforme de conformité qui ne s’ap: A compliance platform that does not apply to itself what it recommends is not credible. This page can be verified by the client: that is its purpose.
texte.Une procédure de retrait improvisée met: An improvised withdrawal procedure takes weeks. Written in advance, it takes days — and that is the difference the authority will look at.
texte.Une procédure permet l'accès, la rectifi: A procedure enables access, rectification and erasure
texte.Une proposition dont les extraits ne se: A proposal whose excerpts cannot be found word for word in your declaration is rejected before it is shown to you. If many end up as “to be completed”, the defect is in the register, not in the engine: it is the purposes that are missing.
texte.Une proposition qui porte ses hypothèses: A proposal that carries its assumptions and holds up in an investment committee, not only in a sales meeting.
texte.Une purge ou anonymisation automatique e: An automatic purge or anonymisation is planned at the deadline
texte.Une revue humaine purement formelle ne s: A purely formal human review is not enough.
texte.Une réponse rédigée par un modèle et pub: A response drafted by a model and published under the institution’s name falls under Article # as soon as it can pass for human.
texte.Une trace datée écrite pendant la crise: A dated trace written during the crisis is worth more than a reconstruction written afterwards. It takes two minutes, at the moment when nobody has any.
texte.Une vague # déclarée finie au jour du dé: A wave # declared finished on deployment day lets abandonment happen without a witness, and the programme ends on its best day.
texte.Une vision consolidée avant d’agir, et u: A consolidated view before acting, and an entry point to each module.
texte.Une vision consolidée pour décider, coût: A consolidated view for deciding, with costs to back it up.
texte.Une vision d’ensemble qu’aucun tableau E: An overall view that no scattered Excel spreadsheet can offer at this scale.
texte.Une vue synthétique immédiatement lisibl: A summary view that senior management can read immediately, without technical jargon.
texte.Une vérification non tracée est une véri: An untraced check is a check that did not take place, from an authority’s point of view.
texte.Une échéance anticipée est un arbitrage: A deadline anticipated is a trade-off; discovered late, it means reworking the file in a hurry.
texte.Une étape ne compte que si ce parcours v: A step only counts if this path led you to it — opening the same page from the menu does not advance a path you are not following.
texte.Une évaluation qui ne progresse pas d’un: An assessment that does not progress from one year to the next is a signal in itself: either the recommendations are not being followed, or they are not the right ones.
texte.Une évolution anticipée est un arbitrage: A change anticipated is a trade-off; discovered late, it means rework.

texte.Votre métier n’est pas de concevoir : c’: Your job is not to design: it is to VERIFY, before placing on the market, that the manufacturer has done what it should — and to be able to PROVE it. Article # lists what to look at; this path turns it into a checklist and a place to store the evidence.
texte.Votre système relève d'un domaine Annexe: Your system falls within an Annex III area but meets the exception in Art. #(#) — it is therefore not automatically classified as high-risk. Document this assessment before placing on the market (Art. #(#)): you remain subject to the registration obligation (Art. #(#)).
texte.Vous accédez au plan Gratuit pendant la: You have access to the Free plan for the duration of the trial. When it ends, a subscription will be required to continue.
texte.Vous arbitrez un budget d’IA sans avoir: You decide on an AI budget without control over the consoles that consume it. This path starts from what is DECLARED, never from an estimate made on your behalf.
texte.Vous devez dire où aller, avec quel argu: You have to say where to go, with what argument, and at what price. This path starts from the real market — what is actually deployed — then works down to the costed decision file.
texte.Vous devez faire monter des équipes sur: You have to bring teams up to speed on artificial intelligence tools they know by name. This path starts from what the organisation can do today, not from what it would like to announce — then goes as far as who answers for what.
texte.Vous devez informer sans retard injustif: You must inform without undue delay as soon as you have reason to believe there is a significant risk — provided you find out about it.
texte.Vous devez rendre compte de l’empreinte: You have to report on the footprint of an AI use that you do not operate yourself. This path gives four indicators, their coverage, and names the fifth that is not provided.
texte.Vous développez le système, ou vous le m: You develop the system, or you place it on the market under your name. This is the heaviest regime, and it is built before placing on the market, not after: conformity assessment cannot be made up later.
texte.Vous en répondez aussi, sur votre périmè: You are also accountable for it, within your scope.
texte.Vous lancez un nouveau traitement. Ce pa: You are launching a new processing activity. This path applies privacy by design from the outset, then the DPIA and the documentation.

texte.Vous ne conduisez pas un site, vous arbi: You do not run one site, you decide between several. This path links what the estate weighs, what regulation will require of it, what the next extension will cost, and what your teams actually use of what has been deployed.
texte.Vous ne pouvez pas dire ce que vous avez: You cannot say what you have modified if you do not know what you had.
texte.Vous ne pouvez pas vérifier « la procédu: You cannot verify “the appropriate procedure” without knowing which one was appropriate.
texte.Vous n’avez pas conçu ce système : vous: You did not design this system: you use it under your authority. The Regulation therefore does not ask you for the Annex IV technical file, but for Article # — and nobody will tell you in your place. This path follows your obligations, not those of your provider.
texte.Vous n’avez pas le temps d’entrer dans l: You do not have time to go into operational detail — this path goes straight to what matters for decisions.
texte.Vous n’avez pas à refaire l’évaluation ;: You do not have to redo the assessment; you have to establish that it took place.
texte.Vous n’êtes pas une entité financière, e: You are not a financial entity, and that changes everything: Chapters II to IV cannot be enforced against you, NOTHING of NIS # is set aside for you, and Chapter V reaches you as your client’s counterparty.
